parole.significato: Someone who is backwards, lacking refinement and culture, usually a person of Slavic origin.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish bydło (“cattle”) or Russian бы́дло (býdlo, “cattle”) in online culture; compare the connotative uses of redneck and sheeple.

parole.significato: A dish of braised or stewed sauerkraut or cabbage, with bacon, mushroom and onion or garlic.
parole.testo: From Polish kapusta, Russian капу́ста (kapústa), Slovak kapusta, Ukrainian капу́ста (kapústa).

parole.significato: A crescent-shaped pastry that is popular in Poland and various other Eastern European countries.
parole.testo: From Polish rogalik and Russian рога́лик (rogálik).
